svg.aria-label: How an adapter is proven: farm, fixtures, groundtruth.json, adapter, replay
svg.title: How an adapter is proven: farm, fixtures, groundtruth.json, adapter, replay
svg.desc: A loop with five stations. 01, farm: the real agent CLI runs against a mock model. 02, fixtures: what it wrote to disk is committed. 03, groundtruth.json: one file per agent says what every record holds. 04, adapter: the parser is written against that file. 05, replay: tests run the fixtures through the parser. The first three happen in an isolated runner, never on your history; the last two are what CI checks, on fixtures only. The loop closes when the agent ships a new version.
